dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Two distinct, high-contrast white horizontal bands are visible; the lower band on the greater coverts is thicker and sharper than the upper band on the median coverts.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Prominent, sharp white margins are visible on the outer edges of the folded primary and secondary feathers against the dark grey-black feather centers.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly visible white outer rectrices contrasting sharply with the dark central tail feathers.
